report: Qualification of every candidate probe, by annotation concordance
what_this_cannot_establish: Neither source distributes the oligonucleotide sequence, so hybridisation specificity is not checked and no verdict claims to know what a probe does hybridise. A probe designed from a non-human coding sequence may hybridise the human orthologue with unknown efficiency. 'contradictory' means the identity is unestablished, not that the probe measures nothing.
unverifiable_are_a_stratum_not_a_deletio: Probes whose identity cannot be established form their own stratum. Dropping them from every analysis would quietly delete real biology, so each sensitivity analysis states whether it keeps them.
